uiAutomation.content: window/titlebar/system menu/Minimize/Maximize/Close only; no city controls

sendInput.reason: Global injection cannot target an unfocused game; activation failed, so injection could touch an unowned process.

inGameBridge.fidelity: Semantic UI command toggles phone without desktop input; does not demonstrate pointer location, resident ray picking or click-through guards.
inGameBridge.visualVerification: Bridge UI click reports BizPhone 1.0 clicked; settled game-view image visibly shows collapsed phone. Listing retains hidden button entries and does not itself prove collapse.

inspector.inference: Inspector picking reads Input.mousePosition. Direct Open/select or EventSystem calls bypass native pointer discovery and cannot certify hover, HUD exclusion or click-through safety.
